notes.title: Patchnote v1.03
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

New update to fix some issues:
- Video achievements x3/x6. This achievement wasn't triggered if you stop playing between completing the first one (1 video released) and the two others (x3 x6 videos released). It's now fixed and retroactive. Start the game and login on your profile to unlock them directly.
- Week 5/6 achievement. A little bug on those two not triggering, now working and retroactive. Start the game and login on your profile to unlock them directly.
- The mission "collect week subs" was popping frenetically. It's now corrected.
- Typos corrected on post 14 and 17!

Adjustment:
- I tweaked the "week timer" as well as the "reduce week timer" upgrade. The week is now shorter (so you can collect money more often but the price of the upgrade to reduce the timer increased. I hope this changes will reduce the "grind" sensation some players may feel while waiting for the week to end!

If you enjoy the game, send us your feedback and join us on [url=discord.gg/SUp8drcewR]Discord to chat[/url]!

notes.title: Patchnote v1.02
notes.content:
Check patch note v1.03 here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483905118929]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483905118929[/url]

Hello everyone,

New update to fix some issues:
- [b]Intruder minigame:[/b] It's now solved. The objects used during the minigame were not given back if you played the SexQuizz just after. With 45 items possible and 15 used every time, it was fast to not have items anymore to complete the game.
- [b]DLC Donator bonuses:[/b] Solved. You can now have your price reduction and special outfit in the Store!
- [b]Subscription plan update: [/b]It was displaying the right numbers but in reality it wasn't giving the good amount per fan when ending the week. Fixed.
- [b]Lewd Pass:[/b] Using a Lewd Pass was showing the fail screen above the win screen! It's now fixed!
- [b]Bonus notif[/b]. It will not appear every 20seconds if you hide it once.

Remaining bugs:
- Some players experience crash during loading.

Check patch note v1.02 here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483899641862]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483899641862[/url]

Hello everyone,

Here is the first patch to answer some bugs found by the community:

Some players complained about the prices of the upgrade in the shop which seem too expensive for the benefits they provide. I reduce the cost of the upgrades but more important the price of the Love Room upgrades to make it easier.
I also increase the money per fan generated to make the beginning of the game a little bit faster.

Love Room (price without Donator DLC bonus):
Level 1: 500 unchanged
Level 2: 800 > 600
Level 3: 2000 > 1000
Level 4: 5000 > 1500
Level 5: 6000 > 2000
Level 6: 8000 > 3000
Level 7: 10000 > 4000
Level 8: 12000 > 5000
Level 9: 15000 > 7000

Money per fan: 
Level 1: $2/fan
Level 2: $3/fan
Level 3: $4/fan

KNOWN ISSUES
- [b]Intruder minigame blank.[/b] Some players reported that this minigame is empty at start. I didn't found the issue for now but still searching. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483899641862]FIXED v1.02[/url]
- [b]The Donator DLC.[/b] It was displayed as OFF in the shop, all features related to it are deactivated.[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1731240/view/5294547483899641862]FIXED v1.02[/url]
